commit.message:
Add documentation for signal handling in launch (#1025)

Adds a signal handling page to the launch docs which describes how
launch handles SIGINT and SIGTERM, how it shuts down the processes it
started, why it works that way, and some history of how it got here.

This describes the behavior after ros2/launch#712, so it should be
merged after that.

Also updates the AsyncSafeSignalManager docstring to match the changes
in ros2/launch#712, and fixes single backticks in architecture.rst,
which were rendering as italics rather than as inline code.

Signed-off-by: William Woodall <wjwwood@google.com>

commit.message:
Describe nested substitutions in conditional expressions (#1012)

Render child substitution descriptions instead of Python object representations in boolean, comparison, and conditional substitutions. Preserve concatenated fragments and operand boundaries without evaluating launch configurations.

Share the comparison description implementation with NotEqualsSubstitution. Extend existing tests with representative nested, concatenated, and conditional descriptions.

Signed-off-by: shkwon <shkwon@tommoro.ai>

commit.message:
Preserve CTest target identity in JUnit results (#1002)

* Preserve CTest target names in JUnit results

Signed-off-by: 渠超胜 <quchaosheng000406@163.com>

* Test unique JUnit class names

Signed-off-by: 渠超胜 <quchaosheng000406@163.com>

* Append the CTest target to the class name instead of prefixing it

Jenkins's JUnit plugin splits testcase classname on the last '.'
into (packageName, className), and the default report grouping is
by packageName.  Prefixing puts the CTest target in front of the
package name, so every target becomes its own package and the
grouping under ${PROJECT_NAME} is lost.

Append the target to the class name instead, separated by two
underscores, so packageName stays the package.  getFullName(), the
key used to look up the previous result, still changes with the
target, so failure age stays per-target.

Replace '.' with '_' in the target: add_launch_test() defaults
TARGET to the test file name, and a '.py' segment would introduce
another dot.

Signed-off-by: 渠超胜 <quchaosheng000406@163.com>

* Fix flake8 and pep257 lint errors in test_xml_output.py

Signed-off-by: William Woodall <wjwwood@google.com>

Signed-off-by: William Woodall <wjwwood@google.com>
